title: Descansa Para Volver
style: modern Spanish, flamenco pop, female lead vocal, Spanish guitar, warm bass groove, inspirational, building anthem, bilingual English and Spanish, choir finale, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro]

(spoken, whisper)

El cuerpo habla.

Escúchalo.

Descansa.

Y vuelve más fuerte.

[Verse 1]

Hoy el cuerpo pide calma

No es rendirse, es dar el alma

El descanso no es derrota

Es la fuerza que se nota

Cierra los ojos, deja ir

El mañana está por venir

Cada músculo recuerda

Cada hora que se entrega

[Pre-Chorus]

No puedes dar lo que no tienes

Rest is where the power grows

Tienes que parar para volver

You have to stop to let it flow

[Chorus]

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

REST TO COME BACK STRONGER

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

THE BODY NEEDS THE NIGHT

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

MAÑANA ERES MÁS GRANDE

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

TOMORROW YOU IGNITE

[Verse 2]

You gave everything out on that court today

Every rally, every point, every play

The muscle fibres working to rebuild

In the quiet hours while the world is still

Sleep is where the training takes its hold

Where the body does the work the coaches told

Every hour of rest is an hour of gain

The strongest players know to rest between the pain

[Pre-Chorus]

You can't pour from what ran dry

Rest is how you learn to fly

Para ganar tienes que parar

To reach the top you need to rest where you are

[Chorus]

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

REST TO COME BACK STRONGER

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

THE BODY NEEDS THE NIGHT

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

MAÑANA ERES MÁS GRANDE

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

TOMORROW YOU IGNITE

[Bridge]

(spoken)

The greatest players in the world know this.

Rest is not the absence of work.

Rest is the work.

While you sleep, the muscle repairs.

While you are still, the mind resets.

While you breathe slow, the fire rebuilds.

You are not done.

You are reloading.

Mañana, tomorrow,

you walk back on that court

and they will feel the difference.

Because you rested.

Because you listened.

Because you came back whole.

[Verse 3]

No te rindas, solo para

Don't give up, just pause and breathe

El descanso es la jornada

Rest is part of how you achieve

Agua, comida, sueño y calma

Water, food, sleep and peace

El cuerpo es tu mejor arma

The body is your masterpiece

Cuídalo como cuidas el juego

Treat it like you treat the game

Porque sin él no hay regreso

Because without it nothing's the same

[Final Chorus]

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

REST TO COME BACK STRONGER

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

THE BODY NEEDS THE NIGHT

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

MAÑANA ERES MÁS GRANDE

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

TOMORROW YOU IGNITE

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

EL FUEGO SIGUE ARDIENDO

DESCANSA PARA VOLVER

THE FIRE IS STILL ALIVE

[Outro]

(spoken)

Descansa.

Rest.

Vuelve.

Come back.

Más fuerte.

Stronger.

Siempre.

Always.
